articles.title: Payment giants Stripe, Visa, Mastercard said to be among backers of soon-to-debut stablecoin platform
articles.snippet: U.S. crypto exchange Coinbase is also said to be looking into the possibility of participating in the new stablecoin platform.

articles.title: UK regulator warns Premier League clubs over unauthorized crypto sponsors
articles.snippet: The FCA has urged clubs to rethink deals with unauthorized crypto and trading sponsors, warning that fans risk losing all their money and teams face legal and reputational fallout.

articles.title: Bitcoin has hit 'max fear' below $67K as analysis sees BTC price rebound
articles.snippet: Bitcoin sparked two-month lows in the Crypto Fear & Greed Index while analysis predicted a "catch-up" with record highs in stocks.

articles.title: Crypto PACs pour $3M into Maryland races as California voters head to polls
articles.snippet: An affiliate of a political action committee backed by crypto companies ramped up spending on ads in California ahead of Tuesday’s primaries, but still has millions of dollars at stake in Maryland later this month.

articles.title: As Oil Moves Higher, Bitcoin Sinks to Lowest Price Since March
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell to a more than two-month low alongside U.S. stocks after Middle East skirmishes pushed bond yields and oil prices higher.
